claims.says: Scientists defined the human prefrontal cortex in three wildly different ways.
claims.evidence: There are three possible ways to define the prefrontal cortex

claims.says: Some researchers used the cortical granular layer four.
claims.evidence: defined based on cytoarchitectonics by the presence of a cortical granular layer IV

claims.says: Others tracked projections from the thalamus entirely.
claims.evidence: projection zone of the medial dorsal nucleus of the thalamus

claims.says: And one definition just checked where electrical shocks caused no physical movement.
claims.evidence: part of the frontal cortex whose electrical stimulation does not evoke movements

script.title: Why the brain has three definitions
segments: Scientists defined the human prefrontal cortex in three wildly different ways.
Some researchers used the cortical granular layer four.
Others tracked projections from the thalamus entirely.
And one definition just checked where electrical shocks caused no physical movement.
